description: Create expense category - server assigns C### code, category is active by default
steps: Step 1: Navigate to categories page at /categories
Step 2: Click create category button
Step 3: Enter name 'Groceries Test'
Step 4: Select 'expense' kind
Step 5: Submit form via POST /api/categories
Step 6: Verify response 201 with data.code matching C### pattern
Step 7: Verify data.is_active is true
Step 8: Verify data.is_debt_category is false
Step 9: Verify data.is_income_category is false
Step 10: Verify new category appears on page without reload

description: Create debt category - server assigns C### code with proper flags
steps: Step 1: Navigate to categories page
Step 2: Click create category button
Step 3: Enter name 'Credit Card Debt'
Step 4: Select 'debt' kind
Step 5: Submit form
Step 6: Verify response 201
Step 7: Verify data.is_debt_category is true
Step 8: Verify data.is_income_category is false

description: Create income category - server assigns I## code
steps: Step 1: Navigate to categories page
Step 2: Click create category button
Step 3: Enter name 'Freelance Income'
Step 4: Select 'income' kind
Step 5: Submit form via POST /api/categories
Step 6: Verify response 201
Step 7: Verify data.code matches I\d{2,} pattern
Step 8: Verify data.is_income_category is true
Step 9: Verify data.is_debt_category is false

description: Category code assignment follows C### sequence for expenses after template
steps: Step 1: Verify template has codes C001-C046
Step 2: Create first custom expense category
Step 3: Verify assigned code is C047
Step 4: Create second custom expense category
Step 5: Verify assigned code is C048
Step 6: Confirm codes are unique for user

description: Category code assignment follows I## sequence for income after template
steps: Step 1: Verify template has code I01
Step 2: Create first custom income category
Step 3: Verify assigned code is I02
Step 4: Create second custom income category
Step 5: Verify assigned code is I03

description: Reject category creation when both debt and income flags are true
steps: Step 1: POST /api/categories with name 'Invalid'
Step 2: Set is_debt_category to true
Step 3: Set is_income_category to true
Step 4: Verify response 422
Step 5: Verify validation error message

description: Update category name successfully
steps: Step 1: Create test category via POST /api/categories
Step 2: Note the category code from response
Step 3: PUT /api/categories/{code} with new name 'Updated Name'
Step 4: Verify response 200
Step 5: Verify data.name is 'Updated Name'
Step 6: Verify other fields unchanged
Step 7: Verify links.self and links.index in response

description: Update category flags when no transactions exist
steps: Step 1: Create expense category
Step 2: Verify is_debt_category is false
Step 3: PUT /api/categories/{code} with is_debt_category true
Step 4: Verify response 200
Step 5: Verify flag updated successfully
Step 6: Confirm no transactions exist for category

description: Reject flag change when transactions exist - debt flag
steps: Step 1: Create expense category
Step 2: Create transaction with this category_id
Step 3: Attempt PUT /api/categories/{code} changing is_debt_category
Step 4: Verify response 422
Step 5: Verify message 'Debt and income settings cannot be changed because this category has transactions'
Step 6: Verify category unchanged in database

description: Reject flag change when transactions exist - income flag
steps: Step 1: Create expense category
Step 2: Create transaction with this category_id
Step 3: Attempt PUT /api/categories/{code} changing is_income_category
Step 4: Verify response 422
Step 5: Verify appropriate error message
Step 6: Verify category flags remain unchanged

Step 2: Verify is_active is true
Step 3: PUT /api/categories/{code} with is_active false
Step 4: Verify response 200
Step 5: Verify data.is_active is false
Step 6: Verify category still exists in database

Step 2: Verify is_active is false
Step 3: PUT /api/categories/{code} with is_active true
Step 4: Verify response 200
Step 5: Verify data.is_active is true

Step 2: Create transaction using this category
Step 3: PUT /api/categories/{code} with is_active false
